sections.title: Payment Gateway
content: Payments are processed through authorised third-party payment gateway providers.
Hariram's does not process or store sensitive payment credentials.
Payment providers use industry-standard encryption and security.

sections.title: Payment Confirmation
content: Orders are confirmed only after successful payment authorisation and confirmation from the payment gateway.
Customers will receive an Order Confirmation after successful payment.

sections.title: Failed Payments
content: Payments may fail due to insufficient funds, bank authorisation failure, UPI timeout, network interruption, or technical issues.
Failed payments do not create confirmed orders.
Customers may retry the payment.

sections.title: Payment Security
content: Hariram's does not store card details, CVV, UPI PIN, or banking credentials.
Customers should never share OTPs or passwords with anyone.

sections.title: Refunds
content: Approved refunds are processed to the original payment method.
Refunds typically take 5–10 business days, subject to the payment provider or bank.

sections.title: Payment Disputes
content: Customers should contact Hariram's if they believe they have been charged incorrectly.
Hariram's will coordinate with the payment gateway provider to investigate payment-related issues.

sections.title: Pricing Currency
content: All prices are displayed in Indian Rupees (INR ₹).
Applicable taxes and shipping charges are displayed during checkout before payment.

sections.title: Changes to this Policy
content: Hariram's may update this Payment Policy from time to time.
The latest version will always be available on this website.
